text:
The plate is about 26 cm across (outer diameter), so it works as a dinner plate. It holds roughly 5 thin fries and 1 small chicken wing drumette, mostly bones with little meat.

Fries: about 5 pieces at roughly 6-7 g each, so about 30 g. At roughly 3 kcal/g, that is about 90 kcal.

Wing: the drumette is small, about 20 g with the bone. The edible part is perhaps 10 g, and it looks mostly eaten. That is about 40-50 kcal.

Total: about 50 g and about 140 kcal.
